n: Single Unit Front Load Washtower™ With Center Control™ 4.5 Cu. Ft. Washer And 7.4 Cu. Ft. Electric Dryer
desc: Make laundry day a breeze with LG's 4.5 -cu. ft. washer and 7.4-cu. ft. electric dryer single unit front-load WashTower. Get more laundry done with the ultra-large capacity washer and dryer that fit more to save time on every load.
hl: Built-in Intelligence Takes Out The Guesswork
Forget about sorting or choosing cycles- built-in sensors use AI technology to detect fabric texture & load size, then customize wash motions and dry temps & more for advanced fabric care.
The LG WashTower™ can also handle common household allergens that attach to your clothing.
Eliminate the Guesswork with Sensor Dry
A built-in sensor detects moisture & auto adjusts drying time- saving energy with less wear & tear.
A sleek, streamlined look with scratch-resistant tempered glass doors are complemented by by rose gold trim.
A Smarter Home Starts with the LG ThinQ® App
The ThinQ app offers control and convenience for smart LG appliances to help you simplify life and enjoy the comforts of home.
All You Want In Half The Space²
Reinvent how you do laundry with room to add a sink, a folding table or organized storage—all with a sleek, streamlined look in half the space² plus easy-reach controls.
